openai.description: OpenAI GPT OCR via Responses API

gpt-6.1-sol.pricingNotes: Standard USD per million input/cached-input/output tokens: $2/$0.1/$10. Cache writes cost $2.5/M. Above 272,000 input tokens the entire request uses 2x input/cache and 1.5x output rates. Estimates use uncached Standard rates; cache writes, Batch/Flex discounts, Fast/Ultrafast tiers, regional uplifts, taxes and credits are excluded. Provider native reasoning default is medium. Page token shapes and latency are inherited from GPT-5.6 Sol and are uncalibrated for this model.

limits.notes: Responses API text/image input, native JSON schema output; 1,050,000 context and 128,000 maximum output tokens. PDF inputs allow 50 MB per file and total request.

gpt-6-luna.pricingNotes: Standard USD per million input/cached-input/output tokens: $0.1/$0.01/$0.5. Cache writes cost $0.125/M. Above 272,000 input tokens the entire request uses 2x input/cache and 1.5x output rates. Estimates use uncached Standard rates; cache writes, Batch/Flex discounts, Fast/Ultrafast tiers, regional uplifts, taxes and credits are excluded. Provider native reasoning default is medium. Page token shapes and latency are inherited from GPT-5.6 Luna and are uncalibrated for this model.

limits.notes: Responses API text/image input, native JSON schema output; 1,050,000 context and 128,000 maximum output tokens. PDF inputs allow 50 MB per file and total request.

gpt-6-astra.pricingNotes: GPT-6 Astra standard rates are $10/$50 per million input/output tokens and $1/M cache reads. Above 272,000 input tokens, the full request uses $20/$75 and $2/M cache reads. OCR estimates and observed-usage cost calculations use uncached rates; cached rates are metadata only, never an unconditional discount. Cache writes ($12.50/M short context, $25/M long context), batch/flex, fast mode, regional uplifts, taxes and credits are excluded. Page/token/latency heuristics are inherited from Sol and remain uncalibrated.

limits.notes: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/images-vision.md documents OpenAI file-input limits of 50 MB per file and 50 MB total across all files in a request. Image-input docs document PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and non-animated GIF support with request-level payload limits.

gpt-5.6-terra.pricingNotes: OpenAI lists GPT-5.6 Terra Standard pricing at $2/1M input tokens, $0.20/1M cached input tokens, $2.50/1M cache write tokens, and $12/1M output tokens. OCR estimates multiply observed or heuristic token usage by uncached standard input/output rates. Batch, flex, priority, regional uplifts, cached-input discounts, cache-write charges, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/images-vision.md documents OpenAI file-input limits of 50 MB per file and 50 MB total across all files in a request. Image-input docs document PNG, JPEG, WEBP, and non-animated GIF support with request-level payload limits.
